payload.posture: Read Luke 24:50–53 as evidence about the Temple, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states after blessing and ascension, the disciples return to Jerusalem with joy and remain in the temple praising God. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Temple.
